name: Tri's head
description: Tri's head, drawn on its own and large, to be composed into `ss.char.tri` by `use` at about a quarter of this size, the way Dot's is. Tri is the spitter: a survivor that let the hive's work be done on it so it could throw acid, and the head says so before the belly does. A white cloth hood is tied close over the skull, stained where the acid has caught it, and a pair of goggles is worn down over the eyes, the glass tinted so the eyes show through it — lidded, with a bile-yellow iris, the near one glancing forward and the far one foreshortened at the far edge. The face shows whole under them on the same three-quarter skull as Dot's: brows up, a straight nose in three-quarter against the far cheek, and the mouth uncovered and a little open, the lower lip full, the near corner stained where the acid comes out with a drop hanging from it. Nothing covers the mouth: a spitter has to open it. Under the jaw the throat has swollen into a pouch — the gland, veined, with a faint bile light in it — over the neckline of the gown, and the hive's work is coming out through the skin in lumps on the jaw, the temple and the throat. No feelers; those are Dot's weapon. No skin but the face and the throat.
